title: May 15, 2026
summary: Participants can now provide an address for in-person interviews, so you can run studies that follow them into their own environment instead of a call. Improvements: Google address fields now return the full address including zip code; observers can view signed consent forms without seeing PII or downloading them; the Members page shows user email addresses, a role breakdown, name/email search, and filtering by role and status; eligibility rules support an 'Any' match mode; cards can be set as default for billing and incentives. Fixes: emails no longer get stuck or orphaned when a connected account is removed; screener changes and edits persist, and library search works as expected; recordings now download as MP4 instead of FLV.
body_markdown: Participants can now provide an address for in-person interviews, so you can run studies that follow them into their own environment instead of a call.
